limitations: Independent reviewer authored none of the outputs. Read only the assigned instruction and review-packet; no treatment identity, resource records, creator notes or other review was read before freezing.

The base sample is symmetric: 1440 entry, 390 entry and 320 decision/failure/success for every variant. Bounded symmetric expansions were 320 invalid for correction access and 1440 full-page entry for contents/artifact explanation and page rhythm.
Optional full-page captures were never used to infer natural post-action visibility. C uses IntersectionObserver reveals; blank areas in those captures are not treated as missing content.
Checks and narrow source excerpts clarify task behavior. No automation suite was rerun, no human/manual test was conducted, and user manual tests remain deferred.

Visual judgments are conditional on supplied normal-color renders and the stated briefs. Ties are deliberate. Procedural blinding may still permit style/source-convention inference; no identity inference was used.

No quantitative aggregate, overall repository winner, model ranking, cost comparison or complete resource claim is made. Accessibility remains unconfirmed; scoped passing checks and incomplete checks do not establish conformance.
